tutorial.welcome.title: Welcome to your café!
tutorial.welcome.text: Your guests order at the register, your team prepares and serves – every guest brings coins. Coins buy equipment and staff.
tutorial.upgrade.title: Upgrade the matcha station
tutorial.upgrade.text: Open the shop (blue cart) and upgrade the matcha station to level 3. You can also tap the counter in the café.
tutorial.station.title: The register
tutorial.station.text: Buy the register in the shop. With it your cashier takes orders faster.
tutorial.staff.title: Your team
tutorial.staff.text: Your founding team: a cashier at the register, a barista at the counter, a waiter for the pass. Hire one more – ideally where the staff panel shows the bottleneck.
tutorial.satisfaction.title: Happy guests
tutorial.satisfaction.text: The face shows satisfaction. Decor, quality, short waits and cleaners raise it – happy guests come more often and tip. Tap it for details.
tutorial.bar.title: Your tools
tutorial.bar.text: Bottom: shop, hype bar (tap the café to fill it), marketing, locations and build (tables, decor). Right: staff with the service pipeline, statistics and achievements.
tutorial.offline.title: Even while you’re away
tutorial.offline.text: Your café keeps earning while the game is closed: for up to {hours} hours, at {pct} % of your income. A store manager extends the time.
tutorial.locations.title: The world is waiting
tutorial.locations.text: From café level {level} you can restart your café as a franchise, earn Zen and open in Kyoto – then Tokyo, Seoul, New York and Bali.
